sloka: अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम् ।जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिताम् ।। ५.५८.१५९ ।।।।
transliteration: athāhaṁ vācamaśrauṣaṁ cāraṇānāṁ śubhākṣarām ।jānakī na ca dagdheti vismayodantabhāṣitām ।। 5.58.159 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thus I was overtaken by sorrow and worry. Just then I heard the wonderful propitious utterances of charanas announcing that Sita was not burnt.
